title: The KARNATAKA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, 2015
full_text: The KARNATAKA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, 2015 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20161 Act Number: 1 Enactment Date: 2016-02-10 Act Year: 2016 Short Title: The KARNATAKA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, 2015 Long Title: An Act to make certain special provisions, to prevent inconvenience to the travelling public by the sudden stoppage of the existing permit holders of stage carriages under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 in relation to the areas of approved schemes and routes notified under Chapter-VI of that Act and to provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
